insights.summary: From the Q1 FY27 investor presentation (no call held): total income rose 49% to a record ₹1,513 Cr and PAT jumped to ₹288 Cr (19% margin) from ₹56 Cr, more than all of FY26, because crude and base-oil prices spiked during the Middle East crisis and the company booked large inventory gains. Volumes grew in double digits in lubricants and exports but fell in domestic white oils, and April volumes were hit by feedstock and port disruption. The chairman expects exports to stay buoyant and is 'optimistic but cautious' given daily feedstock volatility.

what_changed.text: Record quarter driven by inventory gains from the crude spike (EBITDA margin 26% vs 6-8% normally)
Exports expected to stay buoyant in coming quarters

tone.label: cautious
tone.quote: The Company remains optimistic but cautious as it manages a period of significant daily volatility in key feedstock supplies.

red_flags.text: Q1 profit is mostly one-off inventory gains; reverses if crude and base-oil prices fall.
Domestic white-oil volumes fell; April volumes hit by feedstock and port disruption.
No earnings call or Q&A to explain the quarter.

watch_next: EBITDA margin as inventory gains fade (normal 6-8%)
